****_Green Lantern_ (Volume 5) #0**** is an issue of the series [_Green Lantern_ (Volume 5)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Lantern_Vol_5 "Green Lantern Vol 5") with a cover date of [November, 2012](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2012,_November "Category:2012, November"). It was published on September 5, 2012.

## Synopsis for "The New Normal"

Years ago, young Simon Baz and his family watch the September, 2001 attacks on TV. For many years since then, Simon and his family have faced abuse and suspicion from people.

Meanwhile, the interrogation is overseen by Agent Crippen, who believes Simon to be a terrorist. Although Fed is not sure about torturing Simon, Crippen states that if they don't do what needs to be done, then perhaps Fed's son might still be alive after what happened in 2001. Crippen also says that because Waller is protecting Fed, he can't force Fed to do anything, unless he disobeys orders. Fed agrees to continue the interrogation.

As the guards force him into the table, Simon fights back but then a guard threatens him with a gun. Suddenly, a malfunctioning Green Lantern ring breaks through the roof, having chosen Simon as its new wielder. Using the ring, Simon escapes from the prison.
